metadata.title: Penguin Similarity
metadata.description: Each node is a penguin with complete bill, flipper, and body-mass measurements. Every pair with Gaussian similarity at or above the cutoff is linked; a few strongest lower-scoring pairs join remaining components. Link color shows whether species match.
metadata.attribution: Kristen Gorman and Palmer Station Antarctica LTER; Horst, Hill & Gorman (2020), palmerpenguins, doi:10.5281/zenodo.3960218.

references.title: Palmer Penguins dataset, license, and citation

metadata.weight_formula: exp(-standardized Euclidean distance squared / (2 * similarity_scale squared))
